card.name: Linking words in skin-test and injection routes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'or', ',' and 'and' inside lists of skin-test methods (scratch, prick, puncture). Also words between 'local' or 'repeated' and the injection they describe.

modes.label: Skin-test method lists
modes.description: The joining word between scratch, prick and puncture test types in allergy skin testing.
modes.example: (2) Scratch, Prick<< or>> Puncture Test: Positive Skin Test Control

modes.label: Injection wording
modes.description: A linking or modifying word just before the word injected or injection in local injection instructions.
modes.example: It may be necessary to distribute doses ranging from 20 mg to 40 mg by repeated<< local>> injections in the case of large lesions.

modes.label: Wheal size grading
modes.description: The gap after a wheal size in a reaction grading scale, before the next grade number.
